review_notes: Independently read the complete top-level proposal.json, functionality.md, fact-dispositions.json, and link-dispositions.json. The proposal contains two writes, both to the owned ft_80081A00 subject, and no relational or entity mutations.

Both proposed corrections are supported: x1950 is not cleared on entry, so an enabled probe can return true without a new overlap. The disabled path preserves geometry, x2223_b5, and x1950. The response body does not invalidate this reasoning.
Read both owned files completely in canonical and rendered form, enumerated all eight subjects and 23 baseline facts across both subjects pages, and read all six exact outgoing link records.

Independently checked canonical overlap, eligibility, response, reset/frame caller, environmental caller, and item callback/reset evidence. Rendered aliases were not used as independent behavioral evidence.

Functionality correctly distinguishes interval components from ordinary XYZ coordinates, includes equal-height and edge contact, the strict 0.01f branch boundary, unordered direction comparisons, optional callbacks, multiple-item writes, and deferred raw-pointer lifetime uncertainty.

Retained positive purpose/data-flow descriptions do not assert that fresh contact is necessary for every success. The two baseline claims that do assert that stronger contract are superseded by the submitted writes.
Acceptance does not establish compiled section layout, shell-specific behavior, scheduler guarantees, or original names. Those claims remain specifically deferred below.
